rubric.item: SPEC-01..SPEC-14 correctness and test strength (unchanged since round 1)

findings.issue: The justification says we 'usually close the action'. In this spot HJ always closes it. Every player between the later raiser and HJ has already acted, and a second raise would make the spot re-raise. It also says we call with 'suited aces', but A7s, A6s, A3s and A2s fold.
findings.evidence: Seat order UTG, HJ, CO, BTN, SB, BB. The raiser is at CO or later, so after the raise everyone acts before HJ comes back round. Grid row A: A7s, A6s, A3s, A2s are F.
findings.fix: Optional: change 'usually close' to 'close', and 'suited aces' to 'the better suited aces' (or 'most suited aces').

findings.issue: Carried from round 1, not changed. In BB blind-defence, K9o is C*/F (borderline) while the weaker Q9o, J9o and T9o are plain C.
findings.fix: Mark K9o as a plain C, or explain in the justification why it is the edge hand.

findings.issue: Carried from round 1, not changed. No test checks that a word is a run of letters (A-9). The /\S+/ mutant survives.
findings.fix: Add a case where the justification is 60 numeric or punctuation tokens, and expect the missing-justification problem.

findings.issue: Carried from round 1. chartCell has an extra RangeError that the spec does not list.
findings.fix: Keep it, and note it in the build log as a deliberate guard.

findings.issue: Carried from round 1. The condition 'start <= 0' could be 'start < 0'; both behave the same.

summary: Round-1 MAJOR hj-raise-and-calls-wrong-premise is fixed. Commit 5f18b57 changes only the HJ raise-and-calls entry in src/advice/charts/six-max.json; no other src or test file changed. The new justification describes the real spot: we limped, a later seat raised, at least one player called, and we owe one more bet and close the action. It covers who is left to act, the pot odds, and what the range is built from. It is 74 words, within the 'about 80' limit. The grid matches the text: it re-raises AA-QQ, AKs, AQs and AKo, with JJ R*/C and AQo C*/R. It calls every pair, A9s, A5s, A4s, KJs to KTs, QJs, QTs, JTs and T9s to 87s, with A8s, K9s, 76s and KQo borderline. Continue width is 14.3% (raise 3.3%), inside the 6-18% band. That is now a little wider than CO raise-and-calls (13.4%) and UTG raise-and-calls (10.4%), and narrower than BTN (16.1%). This order fits closing the action against a later, wider raiser. HJ calls the suited aces and kings that CO calls, plus a few more; there are no raise/fold inversions against CO. A non-borderline F cell is still present. The fix-2 gate passes: tests, lint, typecheck, scope and integrity. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings remain. The remaining items are a NIT on the wording, plus round-1 MINOR and NIT items that were not addressed and are not blocking.
